Now enteringThe Front Yard

A haunted house in nine rooms

Hollowmere Manor

Walk the manor room by room: the funhouse, the hall of mirrors, the hotel, the woods, the playroom, the nursery, the butcher’s shop, and the chapel. Something has been following you since the front door. Your only goal: escape the manor. Your left wrist (or the top of the screen) always shows what to do next.

Quest
Left stick walks, squeeze left grip to run. Right stick turns. Reach out and pull the trigger to use things. A switches the flashlight.
Computer
W A S D to walk, Shift to run, drag to look, F for the flashlight, E or click to use things.
Phone
Joystick bottom left, drag anywhere else to look, Use button when it appears.

Warning: loud sounds, screams, jump scares and flashing light. Wear headphones: voices come from around you.

On a Meta Quest, open the game from your own web address in the Quest Browser and an Enter VR button appears.
